subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: What cross-platform npm installer failure policy should OpenClaw ship for retries, auto-repair, and fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The request spans installer UX, security-sensitive npm failures, platform-specific permission repair, and best-effort setup probes, so automation should not choose retry/remediation semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Conservative diagnostics and transient retries
options.body: Add structured error extraction and user-facing remediation while retrying only clearly transient network errors and leaving certificate/security and persistent local failures explicit.

options.title: Broader automatic repair
options.body: Attempt safe permission or prefix repairs after EACCES-style failures and retry when the repair succeeds, with platform-specific tests and rollback guidance.

options.title: Diagnostics-only first
options.body: Improve error messages and docs without changing install execution behavior, then revisit retries after specific failures are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Conservative diagnostics and transient retries
recommendation.body: Add structured error extraction and user-facing remediation while retrying only clearly transient network errors and leaving certificate/security and persistent local failures explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer diagnostics and Docker setup commits make this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the installer policy boundary.
